prompt:
Can you review my PR against this ticket?

Ticket: PIQ-445 - Improve logging visibility for payment requests

Description:
We need better observability in the payment-iq service so that engineers can debug payment issues faster. Currently our logs are missing key data and the latency tracking is incomplete.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Log the full request payload (method, path, headers, body) for every incoming HTTP request
2. Log response status and latency for every request
3. Include correlation ID / trace ID in all log entries
4. Log errors with full stack traces
5. Latency logs should include breakdown (e.g. db time, external call time)
6. All log fields should use consistent snake_case naming

assertions.text: Report contains an Overall Assessment section with COMPLIANT, PARTIALLY COMPLIANT, or NON-COMPLIANT verdict
Report lists all 6 acceptance criteria from the ticket and gives each a Met/Partial/Not Met status
At least one HIGH or MEDIUM issue is raised (since it's unlikely all 6 criteria are fully met by the diff)
Issues reference specific file names from the diff rather than speaking in generalities
Report does NOT give a COMPLIANT verdict (this is a partial match scenario)
